/* 부재관리 (7070) */ /* AdminAbsenceMapper.selectList */
SELECT AI_INPT_USER_ID, AI_INPT_AUT_CD, AI_INPT_USER_FA_RE_YN, AI_INPT_USER_ENO, AI_INPT_USER_NM, AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO, AI_INPT_USER_YN, AI_INPT_MGPE_YN, AI_INPT_USER_RGS_DTM, AI_INPT_USER_END_DTM, LST_DB_CHG_ID, TRN_LOG_SRNO, LST_DB_CHG_DTM, (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '120' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD) AS AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL, /* 사용자 권한명 */ (SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS AI_INPT_SNPE_NM /* 담당자명 */ FROM CSPD101TI A /* 사용자 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AI_INPT_AUT_CD IN ('01','03')
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ENO
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ENO DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_FA_RE_YN
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_FA_RE_YN DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ID ASC
